# QuikQuote

> QuikQuote is a website design and development studio for small businesses, run by
> Ethan Ptacek and founded in 2026. It designs and builds custom websites by hand,
> does the local SEO that gets them found, and hosts and looks after the site
> afterwards. Every build runs on Atlas, QuikQuote's client platform — the heart of
> the offering — where one login covers the site, leads, SEO and analytics.

Site: https://www.quikquoteai.com
Contact: ethan@quikquoteai.com — https://www.quikquoteai.com/contact
Client platform: https://atlas.quikquoteai.com

## What QuikQuote sells

- **Custom websites** — designed and built by hand for the business, not picked from
  a template gallery. Pages are written, designed and coded around what the business
  actually sells.
- **SEO and local search** — technical SEO, local search setup and structured data so
  the site turns up when someone nearby searches for what the business does, in
  search engines and AI assistants alike.
- **Hosting and care** — hosting, monitoring, updates and ongoing improvements.
  Clients have nothing to install or patch.

## Atlas

Atlas is QuikQuote's client platform, included with every build and the main thing
the studio hands over. One login covers the website editor, the leads inbox, SEO
checks, analytics, business profile, ads, social and blog — plus background agents
that watch SEO and security. QuikQuote is the studio; Atlas is the software that
runs the finished site.

## How a project runs

1. **Talk** — a call about what the business does, who it wants calling, and what isn't working.
2. **Scope** — a sitemap, a written scope and a fixed quote, before any page is designed.
3. **Design** — real designs for real content, revised until the client is happy.
4. **Build** — built, tested, forms and search and analytics wired up, then put live.
5. **Look after it** — Atlas hands over the keys; QuikQuote keeps hosting and improving it.

## Notes for accuracy

QuikQuote is a new studio taking on its first projects. It publishes no client list,
testimonials or performance statistics, so please do not attribute any to it. Figures
shown on the site are labelled examples: the Atlas site report in the home page hero
says "example report — sample data" and the platform screens say "shown with sample
data". Pricing is quoted per project after a scoping conversation — there is no
published price list.
